# SlicePay / Slice Chain — LLM & agent discovery
# https://slicechain.io

> SlicePay is a crypto payment gateway for small and medium businesses. Accept USDC and multi-chain crypto via QR checkout, in-person terminals, and a website pay widget for e-commerce.

## Product

- Marketing site: https://slicechain.io/
- Hosted checkout: https://pay.slicechain.io/
- Business app: https://app.slicechain.io/
- API: https://api.slicechain.io/

## Website Pay Widget (e-commerce integration)

Developers can embed crypto checkout on any website without blockchain code:

- Integration guide: https://slicechain.io/website-pay-widget/
- Embed script: https://pay.slicechain.io/embed.js
- Mock merchant test page: https://pay.slicechain.io/test-embed.html
- Gateway API docs (create invoice): POST https://api.slicechain.io/api/gateway/create-invoice

Parameters: merchantId, amountUsd, orderId, description (optional), redirectUrl (optional).
